name: ASYMMETRIC_MODULAR_PROJECTION
description: Replaces the algebraic polynomial cancellation with a modular arithmetic condition V_u = (w * x^2 + y) mod x and V_w = (u * y^2 + x) mod y. This completely breaks algebraic factorization and SymPy-based continuous reasoning, as modulo introduces discontinuities. The condition evaluates to equality if and only if x=y, but proving this requires discrete case analysis rather than simple algebraic cancellation.
